tasks.label: CMake: Install Windows ARM64 Debug
args: & { Import-Module 'C:\Program Files\Microsoft Visual Studio\2022\Community\Common7\Tools\Microsoft.VisualStudio.DevShell.dll'; Enter-VsDevShell 409fe070 -SkipAutomaticLocation -DevCmdArguments '-arch=arm64 -host_arch=arm64'; cmake --fresh --preset windows-arm64; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; cmake --build --preset windows-arm64-debug; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; cmake --install '${workspaceFolder}/out/build/windows-arm64' --config Debug; exit $LASTEXITCODE }
